items.name: jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile
items.full_text: Open-source iOS compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone and iPad — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS 兼容层

items.name: onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent
